title: Infinite Decaying Frames
description: A series of concentric, weathered wooden picture frames nested within each other, creating a tunnel effect. The frames show heavy cracking, peeling paint, chipped gilding, and embedded debris against a dark teal and purple gradient background.
prompt: A surreal painting of multiple nested wooden picture frames receding into the center, each frame heavily weathered with cracked paint, peeling gilding, chips, and embedded fragments of debris. The frames are square and progressively smaller, creating a tunnel effect against a smooth dark teal to deep purple gradient background, highly textural with visible cracks and decay.
